title: Onboarding sync, variant B: the progress bar proposal is accepted

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hi Daniel, thanks for making time. I'm Maya Chen, I lead product on the onboarding project.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Hi Maya. I'm Daniel Okafor, I'm the backend engineer on the same project. Let's go through the list.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: First one is the duplicate welcome email. Two users reported it this week.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I've already reproduced it. I'll fix the duplicate welcome email, and I'll have it merged by the end of the week.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good, that one is yours then.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Second, the onboarding checklist copy still says beta. I'll rewrite it. I can have the new copy ready by Tuesday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Tuesday is tight. The design review is on Tuesday morning.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Fair point, let me correct that. I'll deliver the new checklist copy by Thursday instead.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Thursday works.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We could also add a progress bar to the import screen. It might reduce the drop off.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Actually, yes, I'll build the progress bar on the import screen, and I'll finish it by the end of next week.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Good, that one is yours as well.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Now, about the migration script. Last week I said I would write one for the legacy accounts.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yes, that was agreed.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Cancel it. Operations migrated those accounts manually yesterday, so the script is not needed any more.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Understood. The migration script is cancelled.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The release runbook is out of date. Someone needs to update it before we ship.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Agreed, the runbook must be updated before the release.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We are not deciding who does that right now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: One more thing. Do we need legal to review the new consent text?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I don't know, I have not asked them.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let's leave that open until we get an answer.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Anything else?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, that's everything.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Thanks Daniel.
